hero.lede: We are a small team doing high-leverage work, putting founders and brands on the record across India’s biggest media outlets. If you love stories, media and momentum, you will like it here.

sections.label: Why join
sections.titleHtml: Work that shows up in print.

items.title: Tangible output
items.text: Your work ends up in Forbes, TOI and on national stages, not in a backlog.

items.title: Small team, real ownership
items.text: You own clients and outcomes from early on. No layers.

items.title: Learn the media game
items.text: Editors, outlets, shows, awards, you will learn how visibility actually works.

sections.label: Open roles
sections.note: Don’t see your role? Write to us anyway, careers@storybizz.com. Good people beat open positions.

items.q: What does the hiring process look like?
items.a: Three steps: a short intro call, a practical assignment relevant to the role, and a final conversation with the founder. Usually done within two weeks.
Most roles are remote or hybrid, we care about output and ownership, not seat time.

items.q: I am a fresher. Can I apply?
items.a: Yes, media relations and content roles regularly take sharp freshers who can write and follow through.
